title: Reconstruction of pulled-back Koszul Ext from its rank stratum
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], let $\mathcal I$ be its kernel ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let $C=i^*\mathcal I$ be its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Use the derived category and derived internal Hom of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and write $F^q=H^q(R\mathcal Hom_Y(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y))$. Suppose near every $z\in Z$ an affine neighbourhood of $i(z)$ cuts out $i$ by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant with $r(z)=\operatorname{finrank}_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}C_z$, where the module stalk is [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. For every $q\ge0$, let $U=\{z:r(z)=q\}$, the clopen rank stratum [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], and let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ be its inclusion. The restriction-pushforward adjunction unit $i^*F^q\to j_*((i^*F^q)|_U)$ is an isomorphism. The statement computes support only and makes no determinant assertion.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext, Koszul cohomology calculation and local comparison

proof.text: Set U={z:r(z)=q.toNat}. For q nonnegative, q is the integer image of q.toNat. If z is outside U then q differs from r(z), and the off-rank stalk theorem gives a zero source stalk.

The locally constant fiber U is clopen. For its open inclusion j, the invertible counit of restrictAdjunction and the left triangle identity make restriction of the unit M→j_*j^*M an isomorphism. Its stalk maps at points of U are bijective.

The inclusion of U is also a closed embedding, so closedImmersion_pushforward_stalks gives zero target stalks off U. On those points the map between zero stalks is bijective. Therefore every stalk map of the unit is bijective, and isIso_of_bijective_stalkLinearMap makes it an isomorphism.
